title: Intergrate xDrip Sync method to AAPSClient, without the need for xDrip.
symptom: AAPSClient requires xDrip to be installed to see BG data when following, but the user wants to use AAPSClient without installing xDrip.
evidence_quote: Is would be awesome to have xDrip Sync as BG data in Config Builder of AAPSClient, this way we won't need to install xDrip at all....
